met_analysis:
The trough now runs from Gangetic West Bengal to Madhya Maharashtra across Jharkhand, north Chhattisgarh, Vidarbha and Marathwada at 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The trough from northwest Uttar Pradesh to east Bangladesh across Bihar, Jharkhand and Gangetic West Bengal at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over Bihar & neighbourhood lies over Sikkim & neighbourhood at 5.8 km above mean sea level.
The trough from northcentral Bihar to north Odisha across Jharkhand and Gangetic West Bengal at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance as a trough in middle & upper tropospheric westerlies with its axis at 5.8 km above mean sea level roughly along Long. 64°E to the north of Lat. 32°N persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over North Interior Karnataka & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from Comorian Area to cyclonic circulation over North Interior Karnataka across Tamilnadu and South Interior Karnataka at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
